price.helper: Indicative range. You can refine this later.

step4.title: Your story
step4.subtitle: Help buyers understand what makes this business worth looking at.

reasons.label: Why are you considering a sale?

description.label: Describe your business in your own words
description.placeholder: e.g. We run a 20-year-old manufacturing business in Tuscany making custom metal parts for mid-size machinery companies. About 60% of revenue is repeat orders from 8 long-standing clients.
description.helper: What you do, who your clients are, what makes it work.

strongestPoint.label: What's the strongest thing about this business?
strongestPoint.placeholder: e.g. We have a 12-year exclusive supply agreement with our largest client, which accounts for 40% of revenue.
strongestPoint.helper: What would you tell a serious buyer in 30 seconds?

buyerDisclosure.label: Anything a buyer should know upfront?
buyerDisclosure.placeholder: e.g. The current owner is involved in day-to-day operations and a transition period of 6–12 months would be needed.
buyerDisclosure.helper: Risks, dependencies, or anything better disclosed early. Buyers appreciate honesty.
